scenarios.response: Redispatch within 24h. You're not charged for the original booking. Incident logged for carrier rating. You get a Telegram alert before the dock operations notice anything wrong.

We pull BOL photos and condition reports from our archive. File claim with carrier insurance within 24 hours. Track resolution. You don't chase the paperwork.
Driver VIN verification at yard prevents most cases. If it happens, redispatch at no additional cost. One confirmed pickup per booking guaranteed.
We mediate. We know the carriers. Most disputes resolved same-day via our existing relationship with the carrier.
Our archive is the backup. Every document is photographed and stored within 24 hours of delivery. We regenerate what you need.

items.q: How is this different from hiring an internal dispatcher?
items.a: An internal dispatcher is a fixed ~$90k/year cost regardless of volume. You also carry software licensing, training, and vacation coverage risk. Y7 charges a flat dispatch fee per vehicle — scales with your actual volume, zero fixed cost, zero staffing risk. The capabilities are the same: carrier sourcing, rate negotiation, gate pass coordination, BOL documentation, claims handling.

Flat per-vehicle fee based on your typical lane mix. Request a dealer account review and we'll give you the number up front — no tiered games, no surprise surcharges. Same fee whether you do 5 vehicles a month or 50.

items.q: Do I pay carriers directly or does Y7?
items.a: Your choice. Option 1: pay carriers directly at delivery (COD) — you control BOL inspection at door, Y7 bills dispatch fee only. Option 2: prepay Y7, we pay carriers, weekly reconciliation against balance. Both cost the same in total.
None. We onboard single-vehicle pickups and scale with you. The flat fee model makes small-volume dealers economically viable from day one.

items.q: How fast can you dispatch a carrier?
items.a: Depends on lane. Popular corridors (major metros) typically dispatch within 24-48 hours. Rural yards or unusual pairings may take 3-5 days. We tell you the realistic timeline when we quote, not after you commit. Post to Central Dispatch within 30 minutes of your request.

items.q: Can I have multiple users on one dealer account?
items.a: Yes. Invite finance, dispatch, and sales managers with role-based permissions. Finance sees billing. Dispatch sees active loads. Sales sees delivery ETAs for customer updates.

items.q: What about Copart gate passes and IAA buyer letters?
items.a: Included in every auction pickup. We handle Copart gate pass PIN coordination via their Transporter App, and IAA buyer letter setup per authorized carrier. Part of the dispatch department service.

items.q: Do you integrate with my DMS?
items.a: Not via direct API yet. We provide exportable monthly summaries in CSV and PDF that reconcile cleanly with most DMS platforms. Full API integration is on our roadmap.

items.q: What happens if a carrier damages my vehicle?
items.a: Carrier cargo insurance applies (Y7 is a broker, we don't carry cargo insurance — that's the carrier's role per FMCSA structure). We coordinate the claim: pull BOL photos and condition reports from our archive, file with carrier insurance within 24 hours, track resolution. You don't chase paperwork — that's the dispatch department doing its job.
Yes. Dealer trades are a core use case. Often simpler than auction pickups because both ends have dock staff and predictable hours. One coordinated move, one BOL, one invoice line.

items.q: Do you handle customer deliveries from dealer lots?
items.a: Yes. Customer remote purchase → driveway delivery. Full BOL documentation, insured carrier, status updates throughout. Common for franchise dealers and online-first operations.

Simple Broker-Shipper Agreement. Pay-as-you-go with weekly billing. No long-term lockup, no minimum spend, no cancellation fees. Onboard for one trade, scale to full volume, or dial back — all the same account.

items.q: Who do I talk to when something urgent comes up?
items.a: Existing customers reach dispatch via portal or Telegram bot (@y7dispatch_bot) 24/7 for active shipment matters. For new inquiries and account setup, info@y7agency.com responds within one business day.
